items.title: Artie Shaw — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: They start out with Paul Whiteman. I wrote, where was Jean Goldkette? He was the only American jazz band worth talking about in that, in the ’27s.

ctx.x: You were there and he wasn’t.

I was there listening. Of course. I wrote that to the Smithsonian, by the way, on that album they put out, Big Band Jazz, from the beginning. Good God. They start out with Paul Whiteman. I wrote, where was Jean Goldkette? He was the only American jazz band worth talking about in that, in the ’27s. They keep talking about Fletcher [Henderson]. Jean Goldkette had one hell of a band. I said, what about listening . . . why didn’t you guys listen to Clementine? One of the great records of that period.
